displayName: LGD Fin Guard（金融 AI 合规守门）
description: Screen a financial AI system against the three laws of registered, evidenced and gated before it goes live, so licensed advisory, risk-control and anti-money-laundering use cases hold up. lgd-fin-guard — 把 LGD 三律（有籍·有证·有门禁）翻译进金融 / 持牌机构 AI 应用（投顾·风控·反洗钱）的合规守门器，对 AI 系统做三律自评与门禁判定（零依赖）。
